title: A Guaranteed Gator Is a Red Flag
why: Cold, problem-unaware traffic comparing swamp tours: reframes 'guaranteed gators' as a warning sign and positions no-bait kayaking.
hook_options: A guaranteed gator sighting is a red flag.
Ask how they guarantee the gator.
caption: If a swamp tour promises you a gator, ask how. Usually it's food. We don't feed or bait wildlife, ever, so what you see at Manchac is a gator doing gator things. Common April through October. Never guaranteed. Small groups, silent kayaks. #NewOrleansSwampTour #KayakNOLA #ManchacSwamp #EcoTour

slides.headline: A guaranteed gator sighting is a red flag.
slides.body: Here's how some tours make that promise, and why we won't.

slides.headline: Feed gators daily and they show up.
slides.body: Toss food off the same stretch every day and gators learn the schedule. That's training, not wildlife.

slides.headline: A fed gator links people with food.
slides.body: That's dangerous for the animal and for the next person on the water. It's why we never feed or bait wildlife.

slides.headline: Common. Not guaranteed.
slides.body: At Manchac, gators are common April through October, best on warm mornings. Some days they don't show. We say so up front.

slides.headline: No motor. They don't hear you coming.
slides.body: Unbaited gators act like gators. From a silent kayak you watch one sun itself instead of scramble.

slides.headline: Snout to eye in inches = length in feet.
slides.body: Eight inches from snout to eye? Roughly a 7 or 8 foot gator. Our guides teach it on the water.

slides.headline: Egrets, herons, ospreys, bald eagles.
slides.body: Barred owls and prothonotary warblers too. Every one wild, every one on its own schedule.
slides.photo_abs: /Users/wavey/Library/Mobile Documents/iCloud~md~obsidian/Documents/New Orleans Kayak Swamp Tours/Assets/New Assets July 2026/2025 Wildlife & Guests/1000017830.jpg

slides.headline: Twelve guests max. No bench of thirty.
slides.body: Small enough to stop paddling, go silent, and let the swamp come to you.
slides.photo_abs: /Users/wavey/Library/Mobile Documents/iCloud~md~obsidian/Documents/New Orleans Kayak Swamp Tours/Assets/Slack Pull June 2026/web-ready/small-group-kayaking-louisiana-swamp-tour.jpg

slides.headline: We'd rather miss a gator than fake one.
slides.body: Honest odds. Wild animals. A naturalist guide who knows the difference.

slides.kicker: Save this before you book any swamp tour
slides.headline: See the swamp the right way.
slides.body: Small-group kayak tours, 30 to 40 minutes from the French Quarter. Send this to whoever's planning the trip.
